import struct,zlib
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,t=struct.unpack('>I4s',d[p:p+8]);c=d[p+8:p+8+l]
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    p+=12+l
r=zlib.decompress(idat);W,H,bpp=244,32,3;s=W*bpp
prev=bytearray(s);rows=[]
for y in range(H):
    f=r[y*(s+1)];line=bytearray(r[y*(s+1)+1:(y+1)*(s+1)])
    for i in range(s):
        a=line[i-bpp] if i>=bpp else 0;b=prev[i];c=prev[i-bpp] if i>=bpp else 0
        if f==1:line[i]=(line[i]+a)&255
        elif f==2:line[i]=(line[i]+b)&255
        elif f==3:line[i]=(line[i]+(a+b)//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)
            pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
            line[i]=(line[i]+pr)&255
    rows.append(line);prev=line
bg=rows[0][0:3]
for y in range(2,30,4):
    print(''.join('#' if abs(rows[y][x*3]-bg[0])>60 else '.' for x in range(140,244,2)))
